name: Journal of Biblical Literature
description: Articles for the Journal of Biblical Literature: a standard 12-point font, double-spaced, footnotes included; block quotations of five or more lines single-spaced; footnotes in SBL style with no bibliography and no cover page; anonymised, at most 10,000 words.

source.name: Journal of Biblical Literature, Submission Guidelines (rev. 2026-03-27)
source.notes: Not specified, and taken from the general default: alignment, paragraph indent, hyphenation, headings, the indent of block quotations, keywords, page numbers, line numbers. The page size is not stated: letter was chosen for a North American journal. Margins are '1 to 1.25 inches on all sides' (1 inch entered). The font is 'a standard 12-point font ... such as Times New Roman'. Block quotations are in the font and size of the text, without quotation marks. One note per sentence, at its end; no endnotes. No bibliography is sent in with the submission, full details being given at the first citation of each source: the bibliography values are the general default. The abstract is entered at submission. The author's own work is not cited and acknowledgements are left out. Reference style: the SBL Handbook of Style, 2nd ed., traditional footnote style, supplemented by the Chicago Manual, 17th ed.; manuscripts using author-date are returned. Hebrew and Greek in Unicode fonts such as SBL Hebrew and SBL Greek. Submission as searchable PDF, not Word. American spelling.

limits.note: At most 10,000 words including footnotes, roughly 38-40 pages. Abstract of no more than 200 words.
